name: Britannia treat Croissant Mixed Fruit
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, MARGARINE, REFINED PALM OIL, MIXED FRUIT PUREE (4.5%) (APPLE, BANANA, GUAVA, PINEAPPLE), VITAL GLUTEN, BAKERY IMPROVER MIX {EMULSIFIERS [481(i) & 471], ANTICAKING AGENT [170(i)], FLOUR TREATMENT AGENTS [1100(i) & 1101(i)] & ANTIOXIDANT (300)}, YEAST, MILK SOLIDS, EMULSIFIER (471), STABILIZER (440), IODISED SALT, NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, HUMECTANT [420(ii)], PRESERVATIVES (282 & 202), BUTTER (0.14%), ACIDITY REGULATORS (330, 296) AND COLOURS (150d, 129). Numbers in brackets as per International Numbering System) CONTAINS WHEAT GLUTEN AND MILK.
